_comment: Authoritative SEO publish targets, one per tenant. A tenant without an entry cannot be published to. Static-site mechanism: <www_root>/releases/<id> + atomic <www_root>/current symlink served by nginx (the same layout scripts/deploy_website.sh produces). source_files maps a published file to the repository file the site build copies into the release; it must equal the live file before anything is published, and it is updated with every publication so the next deploy_website.sh does not revert the change.
